--- 命令 ---
echo "==任务287727 拉起autoheal+boot脚本补autoheal行=="
echo "--- 1.查guard/remote_ctl是否本该拉autoheal ---"
grep -c "autoheal" /root/azar_guard.sh /root/remote_ctl.sh 2>/dev/null
echo "--- 2.立即拉起autoheal(自带单实例锁,重复拉安全) ---"
setsid nohup bash /root/azar_autoheal.sh >> /root/autoheal_run.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 5
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  if grep -qa "azar_autoheal" "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; then echo "autoheal进程 pid=${p#/proc/} comm=$(cat $p/comm)"; fi
done
tail -3 /root/autoheal.log
echo "--- 3.boot脚本更新(加autoheal行) ---"
echo "" | base64 -d | gzip -d > /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh
chmod +x /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh
md5sum /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh
bash -n /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh && echo "boot脚本语法OK"
grep -c autoheal /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh
